title: Kiritani Haruka — Get Closer & Work Together〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Minori! Kiritani!
Can we have lunch with you guys?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, come join us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's move our desks together!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Alright, let's eat♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Let's eat.
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You two have been out for work so much lately, we've been waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because of that really long shoot, we had to leave in the morning more than a few times.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Wait, was all that for “The Town Revitalization Team!”?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, did you watch?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Of course!
It was so good!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
That town seemed so nice.
All the greenery was really pretty, and the food looked amazing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
The food we had at the eatery and the home cooking they served us was all really, really good!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
...!
I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hanamioka cooking is just the best, no matter where you go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, so... Some of my relatives live there, so I go and visit a lot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, they were really disappointed that the marathon wasn't getting a lot of sign-ups...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: So I was blown away when I saw how lively it had become.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Now I feel even better that we decided to take that offer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
Hehe. It was totally worth all that hard work!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, I've gotta think that it was a pretty tough shoot. On top of it being pretty long, it seemed like you had to do a lot.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Your group chooses which offers to accept, right, Kiritani? Why did you pick that one?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We thought it would give us a chance to show everyone what makes us special.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: What makes you special?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We think it's about us being idols who can just be ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I feel it's really important for us right now to show that to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “The Town Revitalization Team!” was a perfect fit for that.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't realize so much thought went into it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: My agency decides everything for me, so I've never really thought about it that hard.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You really are as reliable as they come, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Heehee. Right?!
Haruka's just that amazing!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: It's true, whenever I see you on something, you really do act just like you always do.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Like when you lost track of where your hammer went while putting that stage together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, I was just...! P-Please forget that happened!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I thought that was great.
It was clear that you were trying your absolute best, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Also, the part where you and Hinomori were helping that lady harvest her crops. I was amazed by how neither of you broke a sweat. All of you must be in amazing shape...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What?! There were way better scenes than that one! Like when they smiled after eating the vegetables they just picked!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, but farming's really hard!
I mean, it's so physically demanding...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know that's what stood out to you. Now I feel a little embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, that was a good reminder of how hard farmers work all the time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were able to help when conditions were good, but real farmers have to work that hard every day, even in bad weather...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I think Hanamioka's vegetables tasted better than anything I've ever had, after I learned what it takes to grow them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't know you felt that way, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We really got to experience something special there.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Your group really is amazing, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Your incredible optimism and work ethic made me want to do my best too!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Me too! I have work after this, and I'm super stoked about it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You two...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks...
Hearing you say that makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, me too! Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I couldn't be more thankful that our classmates see us in such a positive light.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And how we've been able to spread hope like this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We need to keep doing our best to just be ourselves. To be MORE MORE JUMP!)
